d: Ziina is looking for a CRM & Lifecycle Specialist to own lifecycle marketing end-to-end.

This is a high-ownership, high-impact role. You'll own the full lifecycle experience for the businesses and individuals who use Ziina, from sign-up and first activation through to long-term retention, and you'll be accountable for the results. You won't be executing someone else's plan: you'll set the lifecycle strategy, decide what to test, build it yourself in Braze, and report on what it moved.

We're at a major inflection point in our growth, and lifecycle is one of our biggest levers. Your work will directly shape activation, retention and revenue at one of the region's fastest-growing fintech platforms, and you'll work side by side with product, growth and leadership to make it happen.
r: Own Ziina's lifecycle strategy end-to-end: define the journeys, priorities and roadmap for onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and win-back.
Build, launch and optimize lifecycle campaigns and automated journeys across email, push and in-app using Braze. You'll set the direction and be hands-on in the tools.
Own the lifecycle metrics: set targets for activation, retention and conversion, and be accountable for hitting them.
Design the segmentation strategy for both business and consumer users, so the right message reaches the right user at the right moment.
Run a high-velocity experimentation program with the Growth/Engagement PM and Product Marketers, turning growth hypotheses into A/B tests on messaging, cadence and targeting.
Own deep linking and campaign attribution in Branch so every channel is tracked accurately.
Coordinate cross-channel campaigns with the wider marketing team, keeping audiences, timing and messaging joined up.
Own CRM data quality and audience hygiene, working with data and engineering to keep it clean, reliable and actionable.
Partner with design and content to create on-brand, high-converting messaging that reflects Ziina's voice.
Own the health of our martech stack: spot issues, drive fixes with product and engineering, and shape how the platform evolves.
To succeed in this role, you likely
Have 3-5 years of experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally with B2B or SMB products such as merchant platforms, SaaS or B2B fintech.
Have built and run automated lifecycle journeys hands-on in a CRM platform, from segmentation and build through to reporting on results.
Bring a strong analytical foundation and use data to decide what to build, test and scale.
Have worked in a fast-paced scale-up and enjoy creating order and structure out of ambiguity.
Take initiative, bring a bias towards action and want real ownership of the numbers your work moves.
Step back to see the macro view while living for the details, questioning assumptions and using first principles thinking to solve problems.
Manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams.
Demonstrate high integrity, a team-first mentality and a growth mindset.
Are based in, or open to relocating to, the UAE (relocation support provided).
You have direct experience with Braze and Branch, and can hit the ground running without a long ramp
You've built a lifecycle program from scratch or significantly scaled one, and can point to the metrics you moved
You've run lifecycle for both B2B and consumer audiences, ideally in fintech or another regulated, fast-moving environment
You have a strong instinct for copy and know how to write messaging that converts
You're comfortable pulling your own data and don't need analytical support to draw conclusions from campaign performance
You've contributed to martech integration work: Not just using the tools, but understanding how they connect and flagging when something's broken

d: Welcome to MultiBank Group, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

As we continue to expand globally, MultiBank Group is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer - Low Latency Trading Systems (Java/C++) to join MultiBank Exchange. Our leading institutional Electronic Communication Network (ECN) providing deep liquidity, competitive pricing, and advanced execution solutions to financial institutions, brokers, hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, asset managers, and other professional market participants. Our technology-driven platform delivers transparent access to global FX liquidity while enabling clients to optimize execution quality and trading performance.
We are building a next-generation proprietary Trading Platform to power institutional and
retail trading across FX, derivatives, and digital assets. This platform replaces thirdparty
exchanges with a high-performance, low-latency, microservices-driven ECN core. We are
seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in low-latency trading systems,
capable of developing ultra-high-performance components in Java and/or C++, and owning
mission-critical trading infrastructure from design through production.
q: 8+ years of backend engineering experience in high-throughput, low-latency systems.

Hands-on experience with trading systems, including matching engines, OMS and execution systems, market data feeds (FIX, ITCH, OUCH or similar), pricing engines and liquidity aggregation, and risk and margin control systems.
Expert in Java and/or C++ (both strongly preferred).
Deep knowledge of the FIX protocol, trade lifecycle, market connectivity, and execution venues.
Strong experience with multithreading and concurrency, low-latency I/O and memory management, network programming (TCP/IP, UDP, multicast), and Linux systems.
Self-driven, with strong ownership and problem-solving skills in production environments.
Messaging platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Aeron, or similar).
r: Design and implement low-latency trading systems for order routing, matching, and execution.
Build and optimize matching engines, order management systems (OMS), and execution workflows.
Develop high-performance messaging buses for real-time market data and internal system communication.
Integrate FIX engines for institutional clients, liquidity providers, and venue connectivity.
Implement liquidity aggregation, pricing engines, and smart order routing algorithms.
Continuously profile, tune, and optimize systems for minimal latency and high throughput.
Design scalable architectures that handle massive transaction volumes and real-time feeds.
Apply concurrency, memory optimization, and low-level networking best practices.
Implement real-time risk checks, margin controls, and exposure management.
Ensure system stability through monitoring, observability, and proactive performance improvements.
Troubleshoot production issues in latency-sensitive environments.
Own the full development lifecycle: design, coding, testing, deployment, and documentation.
Contribute to architecture decisions, coding standards, and automation initiatives.
x: Work within a high-growth, industry-leading global financial institution.
Fast-paced environment with significant ownership and career advancement opportunities.
Collaborative, diverse, and high-performance engineering culture.
Opportunity to contribute to mission-critical trading applications used worldwide.
